command:
set -eu
CERT=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
KEY=/etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -subject -issuer -dates -fingerprint -sha256
printf 'basic_constraints='; openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -text | awk '/Basic Constraints/{getline; gsub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); print; exit}'
printf 'key_permissions='; stat -c '%a %U:%G' "$KEY"
openssl rsa -in "$KEY" -check -noout >/dev/null 2>&1
KFP=$(openssl rsa -in "$KEY" -pubout 2>/dev/null | openssl sha256)
CFP=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -pubkey -noout | openssl sha256)
[ "$KFP" = "$CFP" ]
printf 'key_matches_certificate=yes\n'
printf 'trust_verification='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$CERT"
printf 'hashed_trust_link='; readlink -f "/etc/ssl/certs/$(openssl x509 -hash -noout -in "$CERT").0"
